audio_evidence.observation: A sparse beat with woodblock/rim clicks, shaker-like percussion, and sustained background tones provides minimal instrumental movement.
Muted melodic synthesizer pads and occasional subtle vocalizations or low-frequency hits enter over the steady, unadorned pulse.
Deep sub-bass tones and ambient synthesizer layers interact gently while the percussion remains very minimal and spacious.

unmapped_styles.audible_basis: Sub-bass pulses paired with minimalist, spaced-out percussion grooves in a calm, ambient tempo.
